# SVG font fixture

`jetbrains-mono-ctty7.ttf` is the unchanged JetBrains Mono Bold subset embedded
by readme-typing-svg in ctty7's README title, captured on 2026-10-05.
It contains only the title's characters and tests font loading without relying
on fonts installed on the test machine. The original copyright is in its name
table. `OFL.txt` contains the project's SIL Open Font License 1.1.

Source: https://readme-typing-svg.demolab.com?font=JetBrains+Mono&weight=700&size=48&duration=3000&pause=1000&color=FF5FA2&center=true&vCenter=true&width=435&lines=ctty7
License: https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono/blob/master/OFL.txt
